ms.report:
Building on the strong foundation established in Milestone 1, we are proud to present the results of Milestone 2. This phase focused on continued video production and the development of supplementary resources to deepen the learning experience for developers across the Cardano and Midnight ecosystems.
Over the course of this milestone, we transitioned from the Testnet era into the Preview network, reflecting the natural progression of the Midnight ecosystem itself. Our content evolved accordingly, from weekly testnet sessions with separate language tracks to a new multi-language format with embedded audio tracks in a single video, making our content more accessible and streamlined for our global audience.
The Edda Labs team continued its close collaboration with the Midnight Foundation team, ensuring all content remains technically accurate, ecosystem-aligned, and responsive to the latest developments.

ms.report:
Closing out this initiative with Milestone 3 has been one of the most rewarding phases of the entire program. Building on the momentum from Milestones 1 and 2, we delivered the final stretch of videos while expanding scope in direct response to the Midnight community. The ecosystem has grown dramatically over the course of this program, with new projects, tools, and partners emerging at a pace we could not ignore. Rather than leave any of those topics behind, we adapted the production schedule to cover more ground without compromising on quality.
The most notable adjustment came in the final stretch. For the last five planned episodes, the community surfaced additional topics they wanted to see covered. We kept the same 3-part format, but adjusted the timing so we could deliver seven episodes instead of five — covering seven distinct topics requested by the community. The total recorded time across those seven episodes is 331 minutes (≈5h 31min) — more than the original five hours allocated, meaning we delivered more content than the original milestone outcomes required. The Midnight ecosystem is moving fast, and we wanted to make sure every important project and tool had a place in the educational library.
The Edda Labs team continued its close collaboration with the Midnight Foundation team throughout this milestone, ensuring all content remained technically accurate, ecosystem-aligned, and responsive to the latest developments.
